🇺🇸🇮🇷 Russia may be helping IRAN PREPARE for a NUCLEAR ESCALATION with the United States.

I had former CIA analyst Larry Johnson back on, as fresh strikes were being reported near Iran's coast and Washington was preparing to tighten restrictions on Iranian supply routes.

But Larry was focused on something happening in Moscow.

Following a lengthy phone call between Putin and Iran's leadership, a senior Iranian official traveled to Russia for hours of face-to-face talks.

Larry believes those discussions went FAR beyond diplomacy.

He suspects Moscow and Tehran were coordinating intelligence, military technology and the support Russia might provide if the conflict escalates dramatically, potentially even to nuclear weapons.

That's his assessment, not a confirmed account of the meeting.

We also discussed Washington's reported $20 MILLION reward for information about Iran's enriched uranium.

Larry previously helped oversee the policy side of the State Department's Rewards for Justice program.

And he couldn't resist pointing out the contradiction.

If Iran's nuclear program was supposedly obliterated, why is Washington offering millions to find its nuclear material?

But Larry is actually becoming more optimistic about avoiding another major war.

He believes JD Vance's diplomatic efforts, Russia's involvement and the prospect of Netanyahu losing power could give Trump a way out.

His biggest concern now is whether Iran will tolerate continued economic pressure long enough for diplomacy to work.

Trump may have stepped away from another major attack, but the strikes, threats and blockade pressure haven't stopped. And neither side wants to be seen backing down.

🚨🇺🇸 The woman who ran the Republican Party for 7 years says voters didn’t reject the message, they sent one back: “We’re not happy”

Ronna McDaniel, RNC chair from 2017 to 2024, says Tuesday was two things at once.

Democrats turned out in a wave, and a chunk of Republicans either stayed home or voted for Democrats, which she calls a red rebellion.

She points to Texas, South Carolina and Mississippi, states she kept red for seven years, where Democrats ran as moderates and won anyway.

Republicans had more money than ever this cycle and it didn’t matter.

A colleague put it to her this way: “We spent millions taking messages to voters and they only wanted to send a message to us.”

Her warning for 2028 is simple... Ohio, Iowa, North Carolina and Texas just flipped, nobody from the party was on a single college campus in Michigan, and the people deciding whether to fix any of that haven’t even started the autopsy yet.
